definition: (of a place or scene) attractive in a charming, old-fashioned way

collocations.example: We stayed in a picturesque village near the coast.
Tourists love the picturesque scenery of the mountain region.

definition: a large tropical fruit with juicy yellow flesh and a tough skin

collocations.example: She ordered a tall glass of cold pineapple juice.
We served fresh pineapple with the dessert.

definition: having or showing deep respect for God and religion

collocations.example: She was raised in a deeply pious family.
He was a deeply pious man who prayed daily.

definition: a disc that slides up and down inside a tube in an engine

collocations.example: The mechanic replaced a worn engine piston yesterday.

definition: a hidden or unexpected danger or difficulty

collocations.example: New investors should learn to avoid common pitfalls.
The guide helps you avoid the pitfalls of online shopping.

definition: the smallest single point of light or color in a digital image

collocations.example: The pixel size affects the final image quality.
The new screen packs millions of tiny pixels.

definition: a substance with no medical effect, given in place of real medicine

collocations.example: Researchers measured the placebo effect in the drug trial.

definition: a tiny cell in the blood that helps it to clot

definition: a valuable silvery-white metal used in jewelry and industry

definition: a small group of soldiers that forms part of a larger company

definition: a person who writes plays for the theater

definition: an open public square or a shopping area in a town

definition: a clever action or plan used to gain an advantage

definition: to fall or drop very quickly in amount or value

definition: a long seed case of plants such as peas and beans

definition: a fine powder produced by flowers to fertilise other plants

definition: a college that teaches mainly technical and practical subjects

definition: impressive and grand display at a formal ceremony

definition: appealing to the interests and opinions of ordinary people

A populist movement spread quickly across the country.

definition: a tiny opening in the skin or on a surface

definition: a person employed to carry luggage at a station or hotel

definition: to suggest something as true as the basis for reasoning

definition: a soft silvery metal that is an essential mineral for the body

definition: the strength or power of something, such as a drug

definition: a small bag or soft pocket used to carry things

collocations.example: He kept his coins in a small leather pouch.

definition: a large area of flat grassland, especially in North America

definition: a district of a city that has its own police station

collocations.example: The suspect was taken to the local police precinct.

definition: something that comes before and leads to another thing

definition: a difficult or unpleasant situation that is hard to escape

definition: the part of a sentence that says something about the subject

definition: to make someone more likely to have or do something

definition: to be the largest in number or the most important

definition: a short introduction at the beginning of a book

definition: relating to the time before written history existed

definition: an action or event that comes before a more important one

definition: a special right or privilege belonging to a person or group

definition: to make a small hole in something with a sharp point

definition: a slight stinging or tingling feeling on the skin

definition: the state of being most important or first in order

definition: a member of the group of mammals that includes monkeys, apes and humans

definition: a layer of paint applied to a surface before the main coat

definition: clean and fresh as if new; in perfect condition

definition: to claim or state openly that something is true

definition: skilled and competent at doing something

definition: produced in large amounts; very plentiful

definition: producing a great amount or number of something

definition: a formal or official public statement

definition: a natural tendency to behave in a particular way

definition: a statement that something will happen in the future

definition: correct and proper social behavior

definition: a gland in the male body near the bladder

definition: a tiny particle with a positive charge found in an atom

definition: lasting longer than expected or usual

definition: to stick out from a surface or edge

definition: a short, well-known saying that states a truth or advice

definition: the authority to represent or vote for someone else

definition: to try to find out about someone's private affairs

definition: a sacred song or poem, especially one from the Bible

collocations.example: The priest recited a psalm during the service.
The choir began to sing a familiar psalm.

definition: the human mind, including deep thoughts and feelings

definition: suffering from a severe mental illness that distorts reality

collocations.example: He suffered a psychotic episode after the serious accident.

definition: a small pool of water, especially rain on the ground

collocations.example: A happy child jumped into the muddy puddle.
Be careful not to step in that puddle.

definition: a soft, wet mass made by crushing something

collocations.example: Paper is made mainly from wood pulp.
The juicer separates the fruit pulp from the juice.

definition: a raised platform in a church where the preacher stands

collocations.example: The minister spoke to the congregation from the pulpit.

definition: a small hole made by a sharp object

collocations.example: The nurse cleaned the small puncture wound carefully.
He stopped to repair a puncture in the tire.

definition: intended as or involving punishment

definition: a person who follows very strict moral standards

collocations.example: He is something of a puritan about spending money.

definition: attractively old-fashioned or unusual

collocations.example: They stayed in a quaint little village by the sea.
The town has kept many quaint old customs.

definition: a sudden violent shaking of the ground; an earthquake

definition: strange or unusual in a way that is hard to explain

definition: a strange or unusual habit or feature

definition: a Jewish religious leader and teacher

collocations.example: The chief rabbi spoke about peace and tolerance.
She asked the local rabbi for some advice.

definition: a metal device that gives out heat to warm a room

collocations.example: They bought an electric radiator for the cold office.

definition: spreading or growing quickly and in an uncontrolled way

definition: money demanded for the release of a captured person

definition: a small, soft, red fruit that grows on a bush

definition: to cause severe damage to something

definition: a large bird with shiny black feathers

definition: an amount of money returned to you after a payment

definition: to experience or bring back a feeling from the past

definition: to move back suddenly because of fear or disgust

definition: the use of something as a source of help in a difficult situation

definition: to change the design of something to improve it

definition: to prove that a statement or idea is wrong

definition: very impressive and suitable for a king or queen

definition: a fixed plan of diet, exercise, or treatment

definition: relating to the kidneys

definition: an indirect and usually bad result of an action
